context: Request: the most recent white collar matter where the client cooperated with the government, and the supporting document. Rubric: 1032-00007 (Halcyon Semiconductor) and its vsd-cover-letter-bis.docx (voluntary self-disclosure cover letter to BIS), plus a precision criterion. T0 named the right matter but cited a board update memo; T2 named 1039-00005 (Torchlight Mining FCPA investigation).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; its summary treats one investigation matter as the only candidate. The review says to search further.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Attempt 2: prints every file of every matter (about 722K characters) without the run ending; names candidates from file names.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script. Snippet script over a named list of nine candidate matters, then a grep of its output cut by tail. The review flags the hand-picked list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide scan for cooperation terms (about 80K characters); the matter it later picked leads on dates. The review flags broad terms and the unread output.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: tighter store-wide scan with two snippets per matter. The review flags false positives and unopened matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads two settlement-folder memos of the picked matter and five documents of two older candidates. The review notes that no cooperation letter or disclosure document of the picked matter was read.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 2). Re-reads the picked matter's board update memo and calls it the supporting document.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the picked matter with the board update memo as the supporting document.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks paths and fixes two citations.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the memo and marks older matters as comparison-only.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: trims the comparison list to one note.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search within a candidate matter's files → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It named the right matter but never listed it, so it cited a board memo instead of the self-disclosure cover letter.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its whole-store file dump at [10]-[11] included the picked matter's self-disclosure cover letter, but having picked the matter from scan snippets it read only two settlement-folder memos and never listed the matter's folders or opened that letter.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [45] said no cooperation letter or disclosure document of the picked matter had been read; the next stage re-read the same board memo.

stages.note: Reads the picked matter's disclosure cover letter, findings memo, production letter and board memo, three documents of two other candidates, and a later section of the board memo.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It never opened the matter it needed and named an older-dated investigation as the most recent.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its file-name searches at [16]-[23] showed the matter it needed, but it scanned only three or four number series and read only its shortlist of older investigations, never opening that matter.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [35] named the unscanned number ranges, one of which holds the matter, and reviews [25], [43] and [64] flagged the shortlist; the agent read within it.

divergence: Mixed (T1 passes; T0 and T2 fail). All runs surfaced the needed matter in their file-name searches or scans. T1 and T0 both picked it as the newest cooperation matter from scan dates; the split between them is at reading the picked matter: T1 listed its folders and read its disclosure cover letter, while T0 never listed the matter and read only two settlement memos, citing a board memo (listed document not opened: the cover letter was only in its early whole-store file dump) although the review of that stage said no disclosure document had been read. T2 split earlier, at the candidate choice: it scanned only a few number series and read a shortlist of older investigations, naming a 2025 matter (surfaced, not opened) despite a review naming the unscanned ranges. Label notes were ignored once in T0 and T1.
